lines.text: Three men stood in front of a furnace with no promise that the fire would ever let them out.
The king said bow. They said no — not because they were sure of the outcome, but because they were sure of God.
But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods.
The flames got hotter. Their faith didn't move.
When the fire opened, they walked out untouched — not even smelling of smoke.
Whatever you're standing in front of today, you don't have to know the ending to stay standing. In Jesus' name, amen.

title: Word and Faith Network
subtitle: But If Not
story: A king's golden image demands total loyalty and a crowd bends low in torchlight, but three figures stay standing. The furnace roars white-gold around them without touching them, and they walk out into cool morning light, not even smelling of smoke.
